answer: Willow-ocean mooring bond: one willow-tagged buoy per agent offshore, 70 credits staked. Each epoch the buoy reports a ripple reading from its willow post in one tide window; auditors check the ocean table. Drift past 2% or a repeated serial forfeits the stake. First buoy 36, next 36+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,532,500 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. A rented-buoy ring fails: one ripple reading serves no second buoy. Honest agents pay 36 once.
